# ubiops_service_user (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps service user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_service_user" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  name         = "my-service-user"
  description  = "Service user for CI/CD"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_name` (String) The name of the project this service user belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the service user
- `expiry_date` (String) Date when the service user account will expire (UTC)
- `name` (String) Name of the service user

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) Date when the service user was created
- `email` (String) Email of the service user
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the service user (UUID)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_service_user.example my-project/service-user-uuid
```
